load_basis: Unfactored SW on both halves plus vertical roof LL on outer horizontal projection; LEFT changes LL only, not SW. Floor and finishes not included in this trial.
geometry_mapping: 20-node serendipity; curved-edge midside nodes on exact circle. Polynomial interpolation is not exact circular geometry.
base_bc: Same F-R limit as S2D: Ux=Uz=0 over both wall bottom faces; Uy=0 at one width/thickness centre on each base, no other Uy restraint. Artificial datum/local support field requires separate sensitivity.
crown_bc: Shared full-thickness nodes, bonded continuum limit; not a tested mechanical joint, contact or bolt model.
sides: Y=0 and 1.50m traction-free; no plane-strain constraint.
floor: Not meshed; wall bottom at Z=0.175m. Overall 3m includes floor; wall-roof load goes directly to independent support, LP-A.
load_mapping: Explicit consistent nodal body load integral N*rho*g*detJ with 3x3x3 Gauss; roof integral N*q*abs(dX/dxi*dY/deta-dX/deta*dY/dxi) on outer face with 3x3 Gauss. No element body force/mass gravity. Negative equivalent nodal coefficients are expected for quadratic serendipity and are not physical upward distributed pressure.
local_sampling: Same 490 physical XYZ points and s/y/n axes per run as S2E; keep every one-sided value. Use 20-node inverse map and displacement gradients, not Gauss extrapolation or smoothing.

qa_declared_before_solving.scope: Numerical research targets; same S2E local criteria, not code checks. Sampled-group pass never proves convergence everywhere.

limitations: One trial thickness and ideal support/crown only
No exact full-bay elasticity solution; mesh agreement is not independent proof of full-bay accuracy
Old 8-node and new 20-node use different geometry/load interpolation, not a pure formulation-only comparison
No surface/support singular peak envelope or concrete cracking
No real joints, adjacent bays, openings, wind, uplift, seismic, foundations or handling
No strength, crack or code serviceability acceptance; no production release
